subject: Missed another play test
author: Xandu
body:
Too bad that you're missing another Burnout Paradise play test. You'll probably forget all about it when you get Halo 3 🙂.

I think after Burnout Paradise the games I'm most excited about is Enemy Territory: Quake Wars (release Q1 2008). I play tested it this weekend and it is probably one of the most awsome FPS I've ever seen. Might do a qucik review of it in my blog later. Unreal Tournament 3 will also be a brilliant game but it doesn't have a release date for the 360 yet.

I voted White Mountain on the poll but I agree with you SUFFUR. I want to change my vote to Angel Vally. It is the most exciting track in the game and probably the hardest one as well.

When will you be back in the UK Suffur?

-- The Creator --

subject: Angel Valley
author: FrozenVapor
body:
Angel Valley is definitely the hardest track in the game (Forward at least... Reverse is easier for some reason), but I couldn't bring myself to call it my favorite. The crap in the alleyways and the unavoidable cross traffic throughout the map just piss me off.

 

I voted for Sunshine Keys. The track is easy, so the races there are almost always really close. Intense stuff. Some of the best races I've ever seen (and by that I mean a real battle for positions) took place on that track. White Mountain is a close second though.
